subject.title: [Feature Request] Group pairing flow: notify owner + read-only mode for unconfigured groups

question: Should the first group-pairing contract drop all pending-group content until owner approval, or may it expose content to a restricted observer before approval?
rationale: That choice defines the security boundary, persistence model, session behavior, notification payload, and whether this can be a bounded admission feature or a broader pre-auth observation system.

options.title: Admission Only First
options.body: Create pending group records and metadata-only owner notifications, dropping all message content until approval and deferring reader mode to separate work.

options.title: Restricted Observation
options.body: Include an opt-in reader-agent path now, with a separately specified sandbox, tool denial, isolated session store, retention policy, and no outbound delivery.

options.title: Keep Existing Allowlists
options.body: Do not add group pairing and continue using explicit group allowlists plus separately scoped warn or auto-leave features.

recommendation.title: Admission Only First
recommendation.body: Create pending group records and metadata-only owner notifications, dropping all message content until approval and deferring reader mode to separate work.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing review already frames the unresolved product and security boundary and identifies the cross-channel decision needed before implementation.
